subject: IonSys demo — leadership presence options & recording preference
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Locke <avery.locke@ionsys.com>, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@ionsys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: IonSys demo — leadership presence options & recording preference

Hi Avery / Miguel,

Thanks again for your time last week — we’re excited to get a short, focused demo on the calendar for IonSys. Before I lock a slot with your calendar team, two quick questions so we can tailor the session and make sure the right people are on the call:

1) Leadership presence: will your CIO or VP of Engineering be able to join for the 30–45 minute walkthrough? If the CIO prefers to be briefed only at a follow-up, tell me and we’ll plan the core demo for your technical audience.

2) Recording & distribution: are you ok with us recording the session for internal reference (Redwood will not publish without your permission)? We can also turn off recording if you prefer.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue, Oct 12 — 9:00–9:45 AM PT (compact walkthrough)
- Thu, Oct 14 — 2:00–2:45 PM PT (preferred for execs)

If neither works, tell us two times that do and we’ll adapt. I’ll keep the session tight: 5-minute context, 25-minute demo, 10-minute Q&A.

Attaching a one-page draft agenda and a short run-of-show for the exec segment.

Best,

Soojin Lee
Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: ion_demo_agenda_v1.pdf (1p summary, run-of-show)

Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IonSys demo — leadership presence options & recording preference

Thanks, Soojin — great to hear. Quick answers from our side:

- Leadership: our CIO is interested but traveling the week of Oct 12. VP of Engineering (Elena Park) can join Thu, Oct 14 at 2:00 PM PT. CIO may join if travel changes — we’ll confirm by EOD Wed.
- Recording: we’re fine with a recording for internal review, but please do not distribute outside IonSys/Redwood — we’ll ask for a short summary deck after the call.

Attendees likely to join: Avery Locke (platform lead), Miguel Torres (procurement), Elena Park (VP Eng — tentative).

Please go ahead and pencil in Thu, Oct 14 2:00 PM PT and send an invite; if CIO confirms we’ll update the attendee list.

— Avery

Ben / Priyom — forwarding Avery’s note. Plan: lock Thu Oct 14 2:00 PM PT as primary. A few asks from my side:

- Ben: can you serve as VP-level backup on the call if Elena confirms last-minute unavailability? We’ll introduce you as Redwood’s engineering sponsor and have one slide on performance & SLOs.
- Priyom: can you prepare a 3–4 slide executive summary (value props + ROI line) and a 1-slide privacy/recording note we can show at the start? Keep it <5 minutes.

On the recording — Avery asked that Redwood not distribute outside IonSys/Redwood. We’ll mark the recording as internal use only and attach the post-demo 1-pager.
